title: Starweaving Lantern Cap
statement: A translucent, paper-lantern mushroom whose cap carries tiny constellations and breathes with a slow amber glow, trailing a lace veil and dewdrop filaments above a moss bed laced with luminous mycelium. Its spores drift upward like embers, and whenever two pass close enough they briefly link with a thread of light, sketching short-lived constellations that no two nights repeat.
